jina: Duty of principal leaders of executive organs to preserve the Union
maudhui: (1) Without prejudice to the duty of every citizen referred to in Article 28, the principal leaders of the executive organs of the United Republic referred to in Article 4 shall each, in exercising the authority vested in him, be responsible for ensuring that he protects, strengthens and preserves the unity of the United Republic. (2) For the purposes of subarticle (1), each principal leader of an executive organ shall, before assuming office, take an oath to defend and preserve the unity of the United Republic. (3) The principal leaders to whom this Article applies are - (a) the President of the United Republic; (b) the Vice-President of the United Republic; (c) the President of Zanzibar; and (d) the Prime Minister of the United Republic.
